{{Top|leg}}
The '''seventh cortex''' was a level in the [[Shaping protocol]]s of the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. It was available only to [[Master Shaper]]s of the [[Shaper caste]].<ref name="rebirth">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref>

Near its outer limits lay the knowledge for the creation of a [[rikyam]], the central brain of their [[Koros-Strohna|worldships]]. <ref name="rebirth" />
